w8-tf-0.en: If a message has been sent and received, effective communication has occurred.
w8-tf-0.q: 只要信息已经发送并被接收，就算实现了有效沟通。

w8-tf-1.en: The Shannon–Weaver model is a linear transmission model that cannot by itself explain interactive feedback and negotiation of meaning at work.
w8-tf-1.q: Shannon–Weaver 模型是一种线性传递模型，单靠它无法解释工作中的互动反馈和意义协商。

w8-tf-2.en: According to the lecture, the 7%/38%/55% rule shows that 93% of all communication is nonverbal.
w8-tf-2.q: 根据课堂内容，7%/38%/55% 法则表明所有沟通中有 93% 是非语言的。

w8-tf-3.en: Formal communication can carry upward and horizontal information, not only downward instructions.
w8-tf-3.q: 正式沟通（formal communication）既可以传递向下的指令，也可以传递向上和横向的信息。

w8-tf-4.en: Classic network studies (Bavelas, Leavitt) suggest centralised networks handle simple problems efficiently, while decentralised networks suit complex problems better.
w8-tf-4.q: 经典的沟通网络研究（Bavelas、Leavitt）表明，集中式网络能高效处理简单问题，而分散式网络更适合复杂问题。

w8-tf-5.en: Media richness refers to the length of a message or the newness of the technology used.
w8-tf-5.q: 媒介丰富度（media richness）指的是信息的长度或所用技术的新旧程度。

w8-tf-6.en: Channel Expansion Theory suggests that the same chat tool can feel richer to experienced team members than to newcomers.
w8-tf-6.q: 渠道扩展理论（Channel Expansion Theory）认为，同一个聊天工具对资深团队成员来说可能比对新人感觉更「丰富」。

w8-tf-7.en: Social media affordances guarantee that knowledge sharing will improve once a platform is installed.
w8-tf-7.q: 社交媒体的功能可供性（affordances）保证了平台一旦安装，知识共享就会改善。

w8-tf-8.en: High-context and low-context communication should not be used to predict each individual's style from their nationality.
w8-tf-8.q: 不应根据国籍，用高语境（high-context）和低语境（low-context）沟通来预测每个人的沟通风格。

w8-tf-9.en: Ravid, Costanza and Romero's (2025) meta-analysis directly proved that generations have no differences in communication preferences.
w8-tf-9.q: Ravid、Costanza 和 Romero（2025）的元分析直接证明了不同代际在沟通偏好上没有差异。

w8-tf-10.en: Employee silence means employees agree with management's decisions.
w8-tf-10.q: 员工沉默（employee silence）意味着员工同意管理层的决定。

w8-tf-11.en: Kluger et al.'s (2024) correlation of r = .39 between perceived listening and work outcomes means listening improves outcomes by 39%.
w8-tf-11.q: Kluger 等人（2024）发现感知到的倾听与工作结果之间的相关系数为 r = .39，这意味着倾听使工作结果提高了 39%。

w8-tf-12.en: Edmondson's (1999) study of 51 work teams found that psychological safety was associated with team learning behaviour.
w8-tf-12.q: Edmondson（1999）对 51 个工作团队的研究发现，心理安全（psychological safety）与团队学习行为相关。

w8-tf-13.en: In crisis communication, honestly separating verified facts from unknowns supports credibility more than false certainty.
w8-tf-13.q: 在危机沟通中，诚实地把已核实的事实与未知情况区分开来，比虚假的确定性更有助于维护可信度。

w8-tf-14.en: Closing the feedback loop on employee voice means managers must implement every suggestion.
w8-tf-14.q: 就员工建言（employee voice）形成反馈闭环，意味着管理者必须落实每一条建议。

w8-mcq-0.en: A supervisor tells a new analyst to make a report 'more strategic', meaning 'show the client our recommendations'. The analyst adds more industry background instead. Where did the breakdown most clearly occur?
enOptions: A mismatch between encoding and decoding
w8-mcq-0.q: 一位主管让一名新分析师把报告写得「更有战略性」，意思是「向客户展示我们的建议」。分析师却加入了更多行业背景。沟通在哪里最明显地出了问题？

w8-mcq-1.en: During a restructuring, an anxious employee reads a neutral announcement as a threat to her job. Which type of noise is this?
w8-mcq-1.q: 在一次重组期间，一名焦虑的员工把一则中性的公告理解为对自己工作的威胁。这是哪种噪音？

w8-mcq-2.en: Different departments interpret 'complete by Friday' differently because they use different standards for 'complete'. Which response best targets this noise?
enOptions: Clarify the meaning of terms, standards and deadlines
w8-mcq-2.q: 不同部门对「周五前完成」的理解不同，因为他们对「完成」的标准不一样。哪种做法最能针对这种噪音？
options: 澄清术语、标准和截止时间的含义
更频繁地发送这条信息

w8-mcq-3.en: A manager wants to check whether an employee has understood a task. Which approach is most effective according to the lecture?
enOptions: Ask the employee what they will do first, what they will deliver and by when
w8-mcq-3.q: 一位管理者想确认员工是否理解了一项任务。根据课堂内容，哪种做法最有效？
options: 提高音量再说一遍指令
请员工说出他们先做什么、要交付什么、什么时候交

w8-mcq-4.en: A company announces it will become 'more agile'. Some staff see opportunity, others fear layoffs. The manager then explains what is decided, what is not, and next steps. Which concept explains the staff's varied responses?
w8-mcq-4.q: 一家公司宣布将变得「更敏捷」。一些员工看到了机会，另一些人则担心裁员。随后管理者解释了哪些已经确定、哪些尚未确定，以及下一步安排。哪个概念能解释员工的不同反应？

w8-mcq-5.en: In a project team, all questions must go to one coordinator who passes information to others. When the coordinator is overloaded, information stalls. Which network is this?
w8-mcq-5.q: 在一个项目团队中，所有问题都必须交给一名协调人，再由他把信息传给其他人。协调人忙不过来时，信息就会停滞。这是哪种网络？

w8-mcq-6.en: A team designing new packaging needs design, sales and production to integrate different knowledge. Which network best fits this task?
w8-mcq-6.q: 一个设计新包装的团队需要设计、销售和生产部门整合各自不同的知识。哪种网络最适合这项任务？

w8-mcq-7.en: A manager must deliver sensitive performance feedback. Which approach best fits the lecture's guidance?
enOptions: An email only, to keep a record
A text message to save time
A private face-to-face or video conversation followed by a short written summary
w8-mcq-7.q: 一位管理者必须给出敏感的绩效反馈。哪种做法最符合课堂的建议？
options: 在全公司社交媒体上发帖
只发邮件，以便留下记录
私下面谈或视频谈话，之后再发一份简短的书面总结

w8-mcq-8.en: A manager needs to find someone among 200 colleagues with specific technical expertise. Which affordances make an internal knowledge platform suitable?
w8-mcq-8.q: 一位管理者需要在 200 名同事中找到具备特定技术专长的人。哪些功能可供性（affordances）使内部知识平台适合这项任务？
options: 可编辑性与隐私（Editability and privacy）
可见性、持久性与关联性（Visibility, persistence and association）
丰富度与即时性（Richness and immediacy）
语境坍塌与持久性（Context collapse and persistence）

w8-mcq-9.en: Long-standing team members act on a one-word abbreviation in the project chat, while new members need explanations. Which theory explains this?
w8-mcq-9.q: 资深团队成员看到项目群聊里一个单词的缩写就能据此行动，而新成员则需要解释。哪种理论能解释这一点？
options: 媒介丰富度理论（Media Richness Theory）
渠道扩展理论（Channel Expansion Theory）
社会认同理论（Social identity theory）

w8-mcq-10.en: After the pandemic, employees of all ages began using video meetings. A manager calls this a 'Gen Z trait'. What is the error?
enOptions: It confuses a period effect with a cohort effect
It confuses an age effect with tenure
It is a correct cohort effect
It confuses horizontal with downward communication
w8-mcq-10.q: 疫情之后，各个年龄段的员工都开始使用视频会议。一位管理者称这是「Z 世代的特征」。错误在哪里？
options: 把时期效应（period effect）误当作同期群效应（cohort effect）
把年龄效应与任职年限混淆
这是正确的同期群效应
把横向沟通与向下沟通混淆

w8-mcq-11.en: An employee reports 'this deadline is impossible'; the middle manager says 'there may be a slight delay'; senior leaders hear 'broadly on track'. Which concepts best explain this?
w8-mcq-11.q: 一名员工报告「这个截止日期不可能完成」；中层经理说「可能会稍有延迟」；高层领导听到的是「大体按计划进行」。哪些概念最能解释这一现象？
options: 选择性注意与行话（Selective attention and jargon）
过滤与 MUM 效应（Filtering and the MUM effect）

w8-mcq-12.en: A manager says 'my door is always open' but interrupts and criticises anyone who brings bad news. Which element of an open communication climate is most clearly missing?
w8-mcq-12.q: 一位管理者说「我的门永远敞开」，但对任何带来坏消息的人都会打断和批评。开放沟通氛围中最明显缺少的是哪个要素？
options: 回应性以及坦诚直言的安全感

w8-mcq-13.en: 'You said the project is on plan. What exactly do you mean by on plan?' This is an example of which question type?
w8-mcq-13.q: 「你说项目在按计划进行。你说的『按计划』具体指什么？」这是哪种提问类型的例子？

w8-mcq-14.en: 'So your concern is about the data, not the budget, is that right?' Which question type is this?
w8-mcq-14.q: 「所以你担心的是数据，而不是预算，对吗？」这是哪种提问类型？

w8-mcq-15.en: A team leader tells staff to 'stay positive' and not escalate problems until they have a solution. Senior management learns of a delay only two days before the client deadline. What is the best managerial fix?
enOptions: Send more frequent progress emails with the same content
Invite risk reporting, thank early warnings, and require updates to list deadline risks and needed decisions
Move the project to a chain network
w8-mcq-15.q: 一位团队负责人让员工「保持积极」，在有解决方案之前不要上报问题。高层管理者直到客户截止日期前两天才得知延误。最好的管理改进措施是什么？
options: 更频繁地发送内容相同的进度邮件
鼓励报告风险、感谢提前预警，并要求进度更新列出截止日期风险和需要做出的决定

w8-mcq-16.en: Which statement about Media Richness Theory's channel continuum is most accurate?
enOptions: Face-to-face is always better than written communication
It is a heuristic ordering; a well-designed written message can outperform a poorly run meeting
Richness depends on the size of attachments
Email is the richest channel because it keeps records
w8-mcq-16.q: 关于媒介丰富度理论（Media Richness Theory）的渠道连续体，哪种说法最准确？
options: 面对面沟通总是优于书面沟通
它只是一种经验性排序；精心设计的书面信息可以胜过一场组织糟糕的会议
丰富度取决于附件大小
邮件是最丰富的渠道，因为它能留下记录

w8-essay-0.en: Case: A project team believes a client deadline is unrealistic. The team leader instructs members to 'stay positive' and avoid escalating issues until they have a solution. Routine updates to senior managers report that the project is on track. Two days before the deadline, the client is told there will be a delay, damaging the relationship. Using concepts from this week, diagnose what went wrong and recommend how communication should be improved.
w8-essay-0.q: 案例：一个项目团队认为客户的截止日期不现实。团队负责人要求成员「保持积极」，在有解决方案之前避免上报问题。给高层管理者的例行进度报告都说项目进展正常。截止日期前两天，客户才被告知会延期，双方关系因此受损。请运用本周的概念诊断问题出在哪里，并建议应如何改进沟通。

w8-essay-1.en: Case: A multinational firm is announcing a major restructuring to 600 employees across three countries. The HR director plans to send one long email full of internal acronyms on a Friday evening. A manager also suggests putting older staff on email-only updates and younger staff on chat-only updates because 'that is what each generation prefers'. Evaluate the plan using this week's concepts and propose a better communication approach.
w8-essay-1.q: 案例：一家跨国公司要向分布在三个国家的 600 名员工宣布一次重大重组。人力资源总监计划在周五晚上发一封充满内部缩写的长邮件。还有一位经理建议只通过邮件向年长员工通报，只通过聊天工具向年轻员工通报，因为「每一代人各自偏好这样」。请运用本周的概念评价这一计划，并提出更好的沟通方案。

w8-essay-2.en: Case: A hospital unit has a suggestion box and an 'open door' policy, yet junior nurses rarely report near-miss medication errors. When one nurse raised a concern last year, the senior nurse said she should 'stop complaining' and nothing changed. Using concepts from this week, explain why reporting is low and what the unit manager should do.
w8-essay-2.q: 案例：一家医院的某个科室设有意见箱，并实行「开门」政策，但初级护士很少报告用药差错的未遂事件。去年一名护士提出担忧时，资深护士让她「别再抱怨了」，之后什么也没有改变。请运用本周的概念解释为什么报告很少，以及科室主管应该怎么做。

w08-p01-0.en: If a message has been sent and received, effective communication has occurred.
w08-p01-0.q: 只要信息已经发送并被接收，就算实现了有效沟通。

w08-p01-1.en: A manager says 'prioritise complaints today'. The employee receives the message but stops all sales work entirely, which the manager never intended. According to the lecture, what is missing?
enOptions: Shared meaning: the employee did not understand enough of the intended meaning to act appropriately
w08-p01-1.q: 一位管理者说「今天优先处理投诉」。员工收到了这条信息，却完全停止了所有销售工作，而这并非管理者的本意。根据课堂内容，缺少的是什么？
options: 信息根本没有传送出去
共同意义（shared meaning）：员工对管理者本意的理解不足以让其恰当行动

w08-p01-2.en: Which of the following is NOT one of the four purposes of managerial communication listed in the lecture?
w08-p01-2.q: 下列哪一项「不是」课堂列出的管理沟通的四个目的之一？

w08-p01-3.en: Shared meaning requires that everyone in the team ends up with exactly the same thoughts about the message.
w08-p01-3.q: 共同意义（shared meaning）要求团队里的每个人最终对信息有完全相同的想法。

w08-p02-0.en: In the Shannon–Weaver model, which sequence is correct?
w08-p02-0.q: 在 Shannon–Weaver 模型中，哪个顺序是正确的？
options: 信源 → 发射器 → 信道 → 接收器 → 信宿（Source → transmitter → channel → receiver → destination）
发送者 → 解码者 → 编码者 → 反馈 → 接收者（Sender → decoder → encoder → feedback → receiver）
发射器 → 信源 → 信宿 → 信道 → 接收器（Transmitter → source → destination → channel → receiver）
线索 → 解读 → 行动 → 更新（Cue → interpret → act → update）

w08-p02-1.en: Because it was designed to explain signal transmission, the Shannon–Weaver model treats communication as a one-way process and cannot by itself explain feedback and negotiation of meaning at work.
w08-p02-1.q: 由于 Shannon–Weaver 模型是为解释信号传输而设计的，它把沟通看作单向过程，单靠它无法解释工作中的反馈和意义协商。

w08-p02-2.en: A supervisor tells a new analyst to make a report 'more strategic', meaning 'show the client our recommendations'. The analyst adds more industry background instead. Where did the breakdown most clearly occur?
enOptions: A mismatch between encoding and decoding
w08-p02-2.q: 一位主管让一名新分析师把报告写得「更有战略性」，意思是「向客户展示我们的建议」。分析师却加入了更多行业背景。沟通在哪里最明显地出了问题？

w08-p02-3.en: Which statement correctly distinguishes encoding from decoding?
enOptions: Encoding is what the receiver does; decoding is what the sender does
Encoding is turning an idea into words, symbols or behaviour; decoding is the receiver interpreting the message from their own background
Both are done by the channel
Encoding only applies to written messages
w08-p02-3.q: 哪种说法正确地区分了编码（encoding）和解码（decoding）？
options: 编码是接收者做的事；解码是发送者做的事
编码是把想法变成文字、符号或行为；解码是接收者根据自身背景解读信息
编码只适用于书面信息

w08-p03-0.en: During a restructuring, an anxious employee reads a neutral announcement as a threat to her job. Which type of noise is this?
w08-p03-0.q: 在一次重组期间，一名焦虑的员工把一则中性的公告理解为对自己工作的威胁。这是哪种噪音？

w08-p03-1.en: Engineers use the word 'done' to mean 'code written', while the client team hears 'done' as 'ready to use'. Which type of noise is this?
w08-p03-1.q: 工程师用「完成（done）」表示「代码写好了」，而客户团队把「完成」理解为「可以直接使用」。这是哪种噪音？

w08-p03-2.en: A frontline worker wants to ask a clarifying question, but company rules require all questions to go up three levels of hierarchy first, so the question never gets asked. Which type of noise is this?
w08-p03-2.q: 一名一线员工想提一个澄清性问题，但公司规定所有问题都必须先往上经过三级层级，结果这个问题始终没有提出来。这是哪种噪音？

w08-p03-3.en: In the lecture, noise refers only to background sounds and technical faults that interfere with a message.
w08-p03-3.q: 在课堂中，噪音（noise）仅指干扰信息的背景声音和技术故障。

w08-p03-4.en: A manager diagnoses that a message failed because of psychological noise. Which response best matches this diagnosis?
enOptions: Add background and context, listen and check how the person interpreted the message
w08-p03-4.q: 一位管理者判断某条信息之所以失败，是因为心理噪音（psychological noise）。哪种做法最符合这一判断？
options: 用浅白的词语替换行话
补充背景和来龙去脉，倾听并确认对方如何理解这条信息

w08-p04-0.en: A manager wants to check whether an employee has understood a task. Which approach is most effective according to the lecture?
enOptions: Ask the employee what they will do first, what they will deliver and by when
w08-p04-0.q: 一位管理者想确认员工是否理解了一项任务。根据课堂内容，哪种做法最有效？
options: 提高音量再说一遍指令
请员工说出他们先做什么、要交付什么、什么时候交

w08-p04-1.en: After a merger is announced, one employee starts volunteering for new projects while another begins updating his CV. Both read the same email. Which concept best explains the difference?
w08-p04-1.q: 公司宣布合并后，一名员工开始主动参与新项目，另一名员工则开始更新简历。两人读的是同一封邮件。哪个概念最能解释这种差异？
options: 渠道扩展理论（Channel Expansion Theory）

w08-p04-2.en: In Weick's sensemaking cycle, which order is correct?
w08-p04-2.q: 在 Weick 的意义建构（sensemaking）循环中，哪个顺序是正确的？
options: 线索 → 解读 → 行动 → 更新（Cue → interpret → act → update）
行动 → 线索 → 更新 → 解读（Act → cue → update → interpret）
编码 → 渠道 → 解码（Encode → channel → decode）
识别 → 梳理 → 检验 → 决定（Recognise → map → test → decide）

w08-p04-3.en: According to the lecture, employees passively copy the meaning that exists in the manager's head.
w08-p04-3.q: 根据课堂内容，员工只是被动地复制管理者头脑中已有的意义。

w08-p05-0.en: According to the lecture, the 7%/38%/55% rule shows that 93% of all communication is nonverbal.
w08-p05-0.q: 根据课堂内容，7%/38%/55% 法则表明所有沟通中有 93% 是非语言的。

w08-p05-1.en: A trainer tells managers: 'Since 93% of communication is nonverbal, the wording of your emails hardly matters.' What is the lecture's view?
enOptions: Correct; words carry only 7% of meaning
Incorrect; the figures came from studies of attitude and feeling cues with inconsistent messages, and task information still needs accurate words
Incorrect because nonverbal cues never matter
w08-p05-1.q: 一位培训师告诉管理者：「既然 93% 的沟通是非语言的，你们邮件的措辞就几乎无关紧要。」课堂的观点是什么？
options: 正确；文字只承载 7% 的意义
不正确；这些数字来自关于态度和情感线索、且信息前后不一致的研究，任务信息仍然需要准确的措辞
对所有口头沟通都正确
不正确，因为非语言线索从来都不重要

w08-p05-2.en: In which situation did the original Mehrabian studies suggest tone and facial expression matter most?
enOptions: Judging a speaker's attitude or feeling when words and tone are inconsistent
w08-p05-2.q: Mehrabian 的原始研究表明，在哪种情况下语气和面部表情最重要？
options: 传达精确的任务截止时间
在言语和语气不一致时判断说话者的态度或感受

w08-p06-0.en: Marketing plans a Monday promotion and first checks stock and delivery capacity with Operations, so the two departments set the launch time together. Which direction of communication is this?
w08-p06-0.q: 市场部计划周一做促销，先与运营部核对库存和配送能力，于是两个部门一起确定了上线时间。这属于哪个方向的沟通？

w08-p06-1.en: An employee notices the new roster leaves one shift unstaffed and tells her supervisor, who listens and adjusts the roster. Which direction is this, and what is its typical risk?
w08-p06-1.q: 一名员工发现新排班表有一个班次没人上岗，便告诉了主管，主管听取后调整了排班。这属于哪个方向的沟通？它的典型风险是什么？
options: 正式；经层层传递而失真

w08-p06-2.en: Formal communication can carry upward and horizontal information, not only downward instructions.
w08-p06-2.q: 正式沟通（formal communication）既可以传递向下的指令，也可以传递向上和横向的信息。

w08-p06-3.en: A store manager sends twelve separate reminders this week through email, chat and meetings, and staff miss the one urgent deadline. Which risk of downward communication does this illustrate?
w08-p06-3.q: 一位门店经理本周通过邮件、聊天和会议发了十二条不同的提醒，员工却漏掉了唯一一个紧急截止日期。这体现了向下沟通的哪种风险？
options: 信息过载且优先级不明

w08-p06-4.en: Informal communication that happens over lunch is just rumour and does not affect how employees understand official messages.
w08-p06-4.q: 午餐时发生的非正式沟通只是传闻，不会影响员工如何理解官方信息。

w08-p07-0.en: In a project team, all questions must go to one coordinator who then informs the others. When the coordinator is overloaded, information stalls. Which network is this?
w08-p07-0.q: 在一个项目团队中，所有问题都必须交给一名协调人，再由他通知其他人。协调人忙不过来时，信息就会停滞。这是哪种网络？

w08-p07-1.en: A warehouse needs to count stock using a standard procedure. According to the classic network studies, which arrangement handles this efficiently?
enOptions: A centralised network with one coordinator collecting the figures
An all-channel network where everyone discusses every count
No network; each person works alone
w08-p07-1.q: 一个仓库需要按标准流程盘点库存。根据经典的沟通网络研究，哪种安排处理这项工作最有效率？
options: 集中式网络，由一名协调人汇总数字
全通道式网络，每个人讨论每一次盘点
没有网络，每个人单独工作

w08-p07-2.en: Classic network studies suggest that centralised networks are always the fastest and therefore best for every task.
w08-p07-2.q: 经典的沟通网络研究表明，集中式网络总是最快的，因此对每项任务都是最好的。

w08-p07-3.en: Information in a team passes from A to B, from B to C and from C to D, and nobody skips a step. Which network is this and what is its main limitation?
enOptions: Wheel; the centre may be overloaded
Chain; low flexibility when work is complex and interdependent
w08-p07-3.q: 团队里的信息从 A 传到 B，从 B 传到 C，再从 C 传到 D，没有人跳过任何一步。这是哪种网络？它的主要局限是什么？
options: 链式；在工作复杂且相互依赖时灵活性低
正式网络；无法传递向上的信息

w08-p07-4.en: The direction of communication and the communication network are the same concept.
w08-p07-4.q: 沟通方向和沟通网络是同一个概念。

w08-p08-0.en: Two employees are in an ongoing conflict and the manager must help resolve it. Which channel choice best fits Media Richness Theory?
enOptions: A group email copying both of them
A facilitated private face-to-face or video discussion, followed by written confirmation of what was agreed
A message in the team chat
A formal report to HR only
w08-p08-0.q: 两名员工一直存在冲突，管理者必须帮助解决。哪种渠道选择最符合媒介丰富度理论（Media Richness Theory）？
options: 给两人发一封抄送双方的群发邮件
由管理者主持的私下面谈或视频讨论，之后书面确认达成的共识
在团队群聊里发一条消息
只向人力资源部提交一份正式报告

w08-p08-1.en: According to Media Richness Theory, a channel is richer when it offers rapid feedback, multiple cues, personalisation and natural language.
w08-p08-1.q: 根据媒介丰富度理论（Media Richness Theory），一个渠道如果能提供快速反馈、多种线索、个性化和自然语言，它就更丰富。

w08-p08-2.en: A warehouse supervisor must tell staff about an immediate safety hazard. Which channel choice best follows the lecture?
enOptions: A detailed email, because it keeps a record
A direct verbal or instant alert that reaches affected staff now, with confirmation of receipt, followed by a written record
A formal report at the end of the month
A post on the company social media page
w08-p08-2.q: 一位仓库主管必须告诉员工一个紧迫的安全隐患。哪种渠道选择最符合课堂内容？
options: 一封详细的邮件，因为它能留下记录
立即通过口头或即时警报通知到受影响的员工，并确认他们已收到，之后再做书面记录
月底提交一份正式报告
在公司社交媒体主页上发帖

w08-p08-3.en: Which statement about the channel-richness continuum (formal report → email → chat → phone → video → face-to-face) is most accurate?
enOptions: Face-to-face is always better than written communication
It is a heuristic ordering; a well-designed written message can outperform a poorly run meeting
Email is the richest channel because it keeps records
w08-p08-3.q: 关于渠道丰富度连续体（正式报告 → 邮件 → 聊天 → 电话 → 视频 → 面对面），哪种说法最准确？
options: 面对面沟通总是优于书面沟通
它只是一种经验性排序；精心设计的书面信息可以胜过一场组织糟糕的会议
丰富度取决于附件大小
邮件是最丰富的渠道，因为它能留下记录

w08-p08-4.en: A manager is choosing how to announce a major restructuring to 300 staff. Which combination best matches the lecture's four checks (message, medium, audience, context)?
enOptions: One short chat message to everyone
A formal written statement for reference, plus interactive sessions to explain sensitive points and answer questions
Only an interactive meeting with no written record
A social media post from the CEO's personal account
w08-p08-4.q: 一位管理者正在选择如何向 300 名员工宣布一次重大重组。哪种组合最符合课堂的四项检查（信息、媒介、受众、情境）？
options: 给所有人发一条简短的聊天消息
一份正式的书面声明供查阅，再加上互动说明会来解释敏感问题并回答提问
只开一次互动会议，不留书面记录
用 CEO 的个人账号在社交媒体上发帖

w08-p09-0.en: Long-standing team members act on a one-word abbreviation in the project chat, while new members need explanations. Which theory explains this?
w08-p09-0.q: 资深团队成员看到项目群聊里一个单词的缩写就能据此行动，而新成员则需要解释。哪种理论能解释这一点？
options: 媒介丰富度理论（Media Richness Theory）
渠道扩展理论（Channel Expansion Theory）
社会认同理论（Social identity theory）

w08-p09-1.en: According to Carlson and Zmud (1999), which four kinds of experience make the same channel feel richer?
enOptions: Channel, topic, organisational context and communication partner
w08-p09-1.q: 根据 Carlson 和 Zmud（1999），哪四种经验会让同一个渠道感觉更丰富？
options: 渠道、话题、组织情境和沟通对象（Channel, topic, organisational context and communication partner）
反馈、线索、个性化和语言（Feedback, cues, personalisation and language）
可见性、持久性、可编辑性和关联性（Visibility, persistence, editability and association）
年龄、时期、同期群和任职年限（Age, period, cohort and tenure）

w08-p09-2.en: Channel expansion means adding more software features or screens to a communication tool.
w08-p09-2.q: 渠道扩展（channel expansion）是指给沟通工具增加更多软件功能或屏幕。

w08-p09-3.en: A manager and a supplier have worked together for five years and now settle complex changes by a short phone call. A new supplier finds the same calls confusing. Which experience types from Channel Expansion Theory best explain the difference?
enOptions: Experience with the topic and with the communication partner
w08-p09-3.q: 一位经理和一家供应商已合作五年，现在通过一通简短的电话就能敲定复杂的变更。一家新供应商却觉得同样的电话令人困惑。渠道扩展理论（Channel Expansion Theory）中的哪类经验最能解释这种差异？
options: 对话题和对沟通对象的经验

w08-p10-0.en: A manager needs to find someone among 200 colleagues with specific technical expertise. Which affordances make an internal knowledge platform suitable?
w08-p10-0.q: 一位管理者需要在 200 名同事中找到具备特定技术专长的人。哪些功能可供性（affordances）使内部知识平台适合这项任务？
options: 可编辑性与隐私（Editability and privacy）
可见性、持久性与关联性（Visibility, persistence and association）
丰富度与即时性（Richness and immediacy）
语境坍塌与持久性（Context collapse and persistence）

w08-p10-1.en: A customer-service team records a recurring system fault and its fix in a shared knowledge base, so new colleagues can search for it later instead of asking the original solver. Which affordance mainly supports this organisational memory?
w08-p10-1.q: 一个客服团队把一个反复出现的系统故障及其修复方法记录在共享知识库中，这样新同事以后可以自己搜索，而不必去问最初解决问题的人。哪种功能可供性（affordance）主要支持了这种组织记忆？

w08-p10-2.en: An affordance is an action possibility that the technology makes available; whether it produces learning depends on norms such as whether people feel safe asking questions in public.
w08-p10-2.q: 功能可供性（affordance）是技术所提供的行动可能性；它能否带来学习，取决于规范，例如人们是否觉得在公开场合提问是安全的。

w08-p10-3.en: An employee complains about a client in a small private group chat. A screenshot is later forwarded outside the company and damages its image. Which digital communication risk does this illustrate?
enOptions: Context collapse: the message left its original audience and context
w08-p10-3.q: 一名员工在一个小型私人群聊里抱怨一位客户。后来一张截图被转发到公司外部，损害了公司形象。这体现了哪种数字沟通风险？
options: 语境坍塌（Context collapse）：信息脱离了原本的受众和情境

w08-p11-0.en: After the pandemic, employees of all ages began using video meetings. A manager calls this a 'Gen Z trait'. What is the error?
enOptions: It confuses a period effect with a cohort effect
It confuses an age effect with tenure
It is a correct cohort effect
It confuses horizontal with downward communication
w08-p11-0.q: 疫情之后，各个年龄段的员工都开始使用视频会议。一位管理者称这是「Z 世代的特征」。错误在哪里？
options: 把时期效应（period effect）误当作同期群效应（cohort effect）
把年龄效应与任职年限混淆
这是正确的同期群效应
把横向沟通与向下沟通混淆

w08-p11-1.en: Hall's high-context and low-context framework is best used as a reminder to notice how directness and politeness may be read differently, rather than as a fixed label for people from a given country.
w08-p11-1.q: Hall 的高语境（high-context）与低语境（low-context）框架最好用来提醒自己注意：直接程度和礼貌可能会被不同地解读，而不是作为给某国人贴上的固定标签。

w08-p11-2.en: A manager says: 'This report has room for improvement.' One employee treats it as a mild suggestion and does nothing. Which adjustment follows the lecture's advice for communicating across contexts?
enOptions: State the expectation explicitly, e.g. 'please revise section two by 3 pm Friday', and check understanding
w08-p11-2.q: 一位管理者说：「这份报告还有改进空间。」一名员工把它当作温和的建议，什么也没做。哪种调整符合课堂关于跨语境沟通的建议？
options: 明确说出期望，例如「请在周五下午 3 点前修改第二部分」，并确认对方理解

w08-p11-3.en: Ravid, Costanza and Romero's (2025) meta-analysis found:
enOptions: Large, consistent generational differences in work outcomes
Few systematic and meaningful generational differences in work outcomes
That Gen Z prefer chat and Boomers prefer email
That communication preferences differ sharply by generation
w08-p11-3.q: Ravid、Costanza 和 Romero（2025）的元分析发现：
options: 在工作结果上存在巨大且一致的代际差异
在工作结果上几乎没有系统性的、有意义的代际差异
Z 世代偏好聊天工具，婴儿潮一代偏好邮件
沟通偏好在不同代际之间差异巨大

w08-p11-4.en: A manager decides who may use email and who may use chat based on employees' birth years. According to the lecture, what should she do instead?
enOptions: Ask each person's task-related preferences and agree a common confirmation method for urgent messages
w08-p11-4.q: 一位管理者根据员工的出生年份来决定谁用邮件、谁用聊天工具。根据课堂内容，她应该怎么做？
options: 询问每个人与任务相关的偏好，并就紧急信息约定一种统一的确认方式

w08-p12-0.en: A manager emails 'send me a good report as soon as possible'. The employee delivers a twenty-page document a week later, which is not what the manager wanted. Which barrier is most directly involved, and what is the fix?
enOptions: Ambiguity; specify what to deliver, to what standard and by when
w08-p12-0.q: 一位管理者发邮件说「尽快给我一份好报告」。员工一周后交了一份二十页的文件，并不是管理者想要的。最直接涉及的是哪种障碍？如何解决？
options: 含糊不清；明确要交付什么、达到什么标准、什么时候交

w08-p12-1.en: A teacher says 'come and see me after class'. A student who just failed a test expects criticism; a student who applied for a programme expects good news. Which concept explains the different reactions?
w08-p12-1.q: 老师说「下课后来找我」。一个刚考试不及格的学生预料会挨批评；一个申请了某个项目的学生则期待好消息。哪个概念能解释这两种不同反应？
options: 知觉与选择性注意（Perception and selective attention）

w08-p12-2.en: A supervisor posts a dozen different reminders across email, group chat and meetings in one day, and staff miss the only urgent deadline. According to the lecture, what should improve?
enOptions: Send the reminders again in all channels
Reduce repetition, agree what each channel is for, and make the few key priorities explicit
w08-p12-2.q: 一位主管在一天之内通过邮件、群聊和会议发了十几条不同的提醒，员工却漏掉了唯一一个紧急截止日期。根据课堂内容，应该改进什么？
options: 在所有渠道再把提醒发一遍
减少重复，约定每个渠道的用途，并把少数几个关键优先事项讲清楚
惩罚漏掉截止日期的员工

w08-p12-3.en: According to the lecture, if a task was not completed, the communication failure must have happened at the encoding stage.
w08-p12-3.q: 根据课堂内容，如果一项任务没有完成，沟通失败一定发生在编码阶段。

w08-p12-4.en: Jargon that works efficiently between experts can become semantic noise when used with new members or other departments.
w08-p12-4.q: 在专家之间高效好用的行话，用在新成员或其他部门身上时，可能变成语义噪音（semantic noise）。

w08-p13-0.en: An employee reports 'this deadline is impossible'; the middle manager says 'there may be a slight delay'; senior leaders hear 'broadly on track'. Which concepts best explain this?
w08-p13-0.q: 一名员工报告「这个截止日期不可能完成」；中层经理说「可能会稍有延迟」；高层领导听到的是「大体按计划进行」。哪些概念最能解释这一现象？
options: 选择性注意与行话（Selective attention and jargon）
过滤与 MUM 效应（Filtering and the MUM effect）

w08-p13-1.en: If nobody raises objections in a meeting, a manager can safely conclude that the team agrees with the plan.
w08-p13-1.q: 如果会议上没有人提出反对，管理者就可以放心地断定团队同意这个计划。

w08-p13-2.en: An employee knows a process makes customers pay twice but says nothing, because last time her suggestion was ignored. Which of Morrison's two questions is driving her silence?
enOptions: Is it safe to speak up?
Will speaking up make a difference?
w08-p13-2.q: 一名员工知道某个流程会让顾客重复付款，却什么也没说，因为上次她的建议被忽视了。是 Morrison 两个问题中的哪一个导致了她的沉默？

w08-p13-3.en: A company installs an anonymous suggestion box but never responds to anything submitted. After a few months, submissions stop. What does the lecture say is missing?
enOptions: Responsiveness: employees need to see that speaking up is safe and makes a difference
More reminders to use the box
w08-p13-3.q: 一家公司设置了匿名意见箱，但对提交的任何意见都从不回应。几个月后，再也没人提交。课堂认为缺少的是什么？
options: 回应性：员工需要看到说出来是安全的，并且能带来改变
更多提醒大家使用意见箱

w08-p13-4.en: Managers should reward accurate reporting of risks and avoid punishing those who deliver bad news, in order to reduce filtering.
w08-p13-4.q: 为了减少过滤（filtering），管理者应奖励准确的风险报告，并避免惩罚带来坏消息的人。

w08-p14-0.en: A manager says 'my door is always open' but interrupts and criticises anyone who brings bad news. Which element of an open communication climate is most clearly missing?
w08-p14-0.q: 一位管理者说「我的门永远敞开」，但对任何带来坏消息的人都会打断和批评。开放沟通氛围中最明显缺少的是哪个要素？
options: 回应性以及坦诚直言的安全感

w08-p14-1.en: An employee complains about a budget request. The manager first says: 'So your concern is that the data cannot be verified, not that the target is too high, is that right?' Which practice is this?
enOptions: Active listening with a reflective check
w08-p14-1.q: 一名员工对一项预算申请提出抱怨。管理者先说：「所以你担心的是数据无法核实，而不是目标定得太高，对吗？」这是哪种做法？
options: 带有反映式确认的积极倾听（Active listening with a reflective check）

w08-p14-2.en: Kluger et al. (2024) reported that perceived listening correlated with relationship quality at r = .51, which shows the two vary together but does not by itself prove that listening causes better relationships.
w08-p14-2.q: Kluger 等人（2024）报告，感知到的倾听与关系质量的相关系数为 r = .51，这表明两者共同变化，但单凭这一点并不能证明倾听导致了更好的关系。

w08-p14-3.en: Edmondson (1999) studied 51 work teams in a manufacturing company. What did the study report?
enOptions: Psychological safety causes higher profits in all firms
Psychological safety was associated with team learning behaviour
Teams with psychological safety never make mistakes
Psychological safety means everyone always agrees
w08-p14-3.q: Edmondson（1999）研究了一家制造企业的 51 个工作团队。这项研究报告了什么？
options: 心理安全在所有企业中都会带来更高利润
心理安全与团队学习行为相关
具有心理安全的团队从不犯错
心理安全意味着所有人总是意见一致

w08-p14-4.en: An employee warns that a new process may fail. The manager thanks her, explains how she will check it, and later tells her which step was changed. Which managerial practice supporting voice does this show?
enOptions: Closing the feedback loop after a concern is raised
w08-p14-4.q: 一名员工警告说新流程可能会失败。管理者感谢了她，说明自己将如何核查，之后又告诉她哪一步做了修改。这体现了哪种支持员工建言的管理做法？
options: 在有人提出担忧后形成反馈闭环
